title: encyclia quesneliana
intro: Encyclia quesneliana, commonly known as the Queen of Night orchid, is a species of orchid native to Central America and Mexico. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels, making it a potential treatment for cardiovascular diseases. The therapeutic actions of Encyclia quesneliana include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help reduce inflammation and oxidative stress in the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
